observations: Photo 0 shows a black DSLR camera body with 'Canon' logo on the front grip and 'Canon EOS 600D' printed on the top right of the body.
Photo 0 also shows a separate Canon EF-S 18-55mm lens and a neck strap printed 'EOS DIGITAL'.
Photo 1 shows the rear LCD screen and control buttons (MENU, INFO, SET, AF, WB) consistent with a Canon EOS 600D rear panel layout.

Photo 2 shows two camera bodies side by side: left one labeled 'Canon EOS 600D', right one labeled 'Canon EOS 700D', plus a separate silver lens marked '28-80mm' and a partial Nikon lens cap visible at top of frame.
No Sony branding, logo, or model text appears anywhere in any of the three photos.
No visible shutter count, memory card, battery, or charger in any photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0, 1, and 2 all show 'Canon' branding and 'EOS 600D' / 'EOS 700D' model text; no Sony markings anywhere.

claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera
claims.evidence: Origin ('UK used') cannot be confirmed from photos; no import sticker, region code, or UK-market marking visible.
Cosmetic condition looks reasonable in photos 0-2, but 'sharp' implies working optics/sensor, which cannot be judged from static photos.

risks.risk: Sensor/shutter functionality and shutter count unknown
risks.proof: A test photo taken with the camera, or a shutter-count screenshot from software like EOSInfo
A short video clip showing zoom ring turning and autofocus engaging
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unverified, worst case

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and memory card inclusion unclear
risks.proof: A photo showing battery, charger, and card alongside the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body/lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Possible listing mix-up: seller's text says 'Sony' while photos clearly show Canon-branded bodies (600D and 700D) and even a Nikon lens cap visible in photo 2 background
risks.proof: A clear, single, unambiguous photo of the exact item being sold with its brand/model fully legible, matching the seller's description
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced until identity is confirmed; treated as a red flag for listing accuracy

proof_requests: A single clear photo of only the exact camera being sold, with brand/model fully legible, matching the text description.
Confirmation of which camera (600D or 700D, since both appear in photo 2) is actually for sale.
A photo or screenshot of shutter count or a test image taken with the camera.
A photo showing included accessories: battery, charger, memory card, strap, caps.
response.reason: The seller's text claims the brand is Sony, but every photo clearly shows Canon-branded EOS 600D (and even a second EOS 700D) bodies with no Sony markings at all; this mismatch between description and photos is a strong listing-accuracy red flag that must be resolved before any pricing.
